freeTaxExplain: This template is a general template with low deployment cost. The only difference from the most basic ERC20 interface implementation is that you can set whether the token can be issued additionally.

feeTokenExplain: This template is the most commonly used fee template. You can set the tax rate to automatically add liquidity to ensure that the traffic pool will never be exhausted. You can also set the marketing tax rate to create additional benefits for the owner. The token supports setting whether it can be issued additionally.
feeTokenV2Explain: This template is the most commonly used fee template. You can set the tax rate to automatically add liquidity to ensure that the traffic pool will never be exhausted. You can also set the marketing tax rate to create additional benefits for the owner.
selfDividendTokenExplain: The template supports automatically assigning its own tokens. During the user's swap of the token, the distributable tokens are automatically distributed to each token holder's account.
addPoolDividendExplain: This template can set dividend tokens. For users who add liquidity pools, the specified tokens will be automatically allocated proportionally. The token supports setting whether it can be issued additionally.
addPoolDividendV2Explain: This template can set dividend tokens. For users who add liquidity pools, the specified tokens will be automatically allocated proportionally.
currencyExplain: In order to carry out normal dividends or income, it is necessary to add trading pairs between the token and the pool token for liquidity addition and swap.
marketAddressExplain: Marketing tax will be automatically transfer to this address.
taxInstructionText1: The following taxes and fees may be involved in the process of buying or selling this token:
taxInstructionText2: Marketing tax: During the transaction process, this proportion of tokens will be sent to the project party's marketing address as the project party's marketing income.
taxInstructionText3: Liquidity tax: During the transaction process, this proportion of tokens will be used to automatically add pool liquidity to ensure that the pool liquidity is more sustainable.
taxInstructionText4: Burn tax: During the transaction, this proportion of tokens will be burned.
taxInstructionText5: Reward tax: During the transaction process, this proportion of tokens will be used for dividends and distributed to dividend beneficiaries.
taxInstructionText6: Please note that the sum of the tax and fee ratios for buying or selling the tokens cannot exceed the upper limit set by the system.
